text: Testing plays a vital role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly on their own. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of the system work well together when combined. A popular approach is test-driven development, where you write a test first, watch it fail, and then write the minimum amount of code to make it pass. While this may seem slow at first, it builds strong confidence. Knowing that your changes haven't broken anything gives you the freedom to improve your code without fear.
